text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp,<n>where
Umamusume train to improve<n>their skills.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I heard Japanese summer camps<n>have pillow fights
at night! Is that<n>true?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Back-breakin' training during the day,<n>then pillow
fights when the sun goes<n>down. Japanese camps
sure are<n>wild...
choice_data_list: (I don't think it's a hard rule...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But that won't be a problem for me!<n>See, I'm
gonna be the first ever<n>sprinter to become
Umamusume of<n>the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll kill it in my training and my pillowfights!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So begins a thrilling summer camp<n>with Taiki
Shuttle!
